evidence.note: The official publisher page identifies Martin Heidegger, the standalone German title and ISBN and advertises this exact image in og:image. Its description explicitly states that this edition contains the original 24 July 1929 inaugural lecture, the 1949 introduction and the 1943 postscript; the lecture text matches the Wegmarken printing. The university-hosted translation identifies What Is Metaphysics? with the same 1929 lecture and cites its German source as Was ist Metaphysik?; Cambridge independently catalogs the essay under the English title. Visual inspection confirms Martin Heidegger, Was ist Metaphysik? and the Vittorio Klostermann imprint on the cover, with no volume/excerpt limitation. The image was fetched with robots checks and existing transport cooldowns and passed the normal image validator. This authorizes a representative work cover only; the German language, 2007 publication year, ISBN and page count are evidence about the pictured edition and must not overwrite the catalog edition metadata. Current catalog work ID, title and authors were rechecked read-only before preparing this candidate.
